question: How many natural isotopes of carbon are there?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Isotopes are species of a chemical element having the same atomic number but different mass numbers.
 
• **C-12, C-13 and C-14** are the isotopes of carbon.
 
• **Hence there are three isotopes of carbon.**
 
• Among them, C-12 and C-14 are used in carbon dating techniques.
 
• C-13 is a stable isotope of carbon.
 
• It is used in **NMR spectroscopy.**
